name: All that Glitters
source:
After you almost get kidnapped, you, along with a handsome captain, seek to get revenge mercilessly cutting down those who stand in your way , until you are kidnapped by a bunch of hot pirates?!

[From [url=https://zedie.itch.io/all-that-glitters]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你差点被绑架。如今你和一位英俊的船长联手，准备毫不留情地砍倒所有挡路的人，为此复仇；结果你却被一群性感的海盗绑架了？！

[来源：[url=https://zedie.itch.io/all-that-glitters]Itch.io[/url]]
